curation.notes: Custom dual-beam 1064 nm optical trap measuring force generation, termination forces, attachment durations and reengagement of dimeric rat KIF1A (WT and loop-12 swap mutant KIF1A-SW) against hindering loads in both a three-bead (microtubule dumbbell over pedestal) and a single-bead assay, compared with KIF5B. TIRF motility and stopped-flow kinetics were separate, non-correlative assays.
